summary: The agent assisted the customer in linking Aadhaar to account.

intents.keywords: Hello, I want to know how to link my Aadhaar...branch help me.

issues.issue: Customer needs assistance linking Aadhaar to savings account.

intents.actions of agent: The agent offered to send a simple form to the customer's email for online submission.
intents.Process Request: Send form to customer's registered email.
intents.resolution: Agent will send a form to the customer's email address to facilitate Aadhaar linking.
